'''Hexx''' was a [[clone trooper|clone stormtrooper]] in service to the [[Galactic Empire]] who operated on the [[planet]] [[Barton IV]] during or after [[18 BBY]]. After being stationed at the depot for more than a year, Hexx was killed in action by insurgents who terrorized the [[Imperial Depot (Barton IV)|Imperial Depot]].<ref name="The Outpost" />

==Biography==
Sometime around [[19 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Hexx and his [[Mayday's squad|squad]], under the command of [[Clone Commander]] [[Mayday]], were assigned to guard an [[Imperial Depot (Barton IV)|Imperial supply depot]] on the planet of Barton IV. After more than a [[Standard year|year]] of being stationed on the post, the majority of Mayday's squad had been killed fighting off local insurgents, leaving behind Hexx, [[Veetch]], and Mayday as the only surviving troopers by the time clone commando [[Crosshair|CT-9904]] "Crosshair" and Imperial [[Lieutenant]] [[Nolan]] arrived to reinforce the squad<ref name="The Outpost" /> during or after [[18 BBY]].<ref name="Date" />

While Crosshair and Mayday were out surveying the depot's perimeter during a blizzard, the Imperial depot was attacked once more by the local insurgents. As he rushed to the depot's defense, Hexx was [[Death|killed]] during the attack. Mayday would later retrieve Hexx's helmet and display it alongside the helmets of his other deceased men inside of the Imperial depot.<ref name="The Outpost" />

==Personality and traits==
A [[Cloning|clone]] of the [[bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett]], Hexx was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] that stood 1.83 [[meter]]s tall.<ref name="Clone troopers" />

==Equipment==
As a clone stormtrooper, Hexx was equipped with standard-issue [[Phase II clone trooper armor]], and was armed with a [[DC-15A blaster carbine]]. After more than a year without maintenance or repair, Hexx's armor was broken and disheveled, and was loosely held together by cloth wrappings.<ref name="The Outpost" />
